ग्रन्थिन् granth-in, a. reading books.
ग्रन्थिल granthi-la, a. knotty.
ग्रप्स grapsa, bunch, bundle.

 grasp.

 -ī-tṛ, m. seizer.

ग्राभ grābhá, m. seizer;

 🞄-stút, m. a kind of priest: -stotra, n. invocation 🞄of the pressing-stones at noon: ī-ya, 🞄a. relating to the invocation of the pressingstones.
